name: Working with Ruslana
source:
Working with Ruslana is a short visual novel in which you, an aspiring adventurer, move to the city of Okenshire in order to join the popular Adventurer’s Guild. 
You get a little more than you bargained for however, as you find yourself working for Ruslana, the mysterious owner of The Rustic. 

[From [url=https://ochki.itch.io/working-with-ruslana]itch.io[/url]]

Same setting as the webcomic [url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/challenge/grimms-adventurers-guild/list?title_no=539117]Grimm’s Adventurer’s Guild[/url]
translation:
《与鲁斯兰娜一起工作》是一部短篇视觉小说，其中你是一位有抱负的冒险家，搬到奥肯郡市，加入受欢迎的冒险家公会。
然而，当你发现自己为The Rustic的神秘老板Ruslana工作时，你得到的比你预想的要多一些。

[来自[url=https://ochki.itch.io/working-with-ruslana]itch.io[/url]]

与网络漫画相同的设置 [url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/challenge/grimms-adventurers-guild/list?title_no=539117]格林冒险家公会[/url]
